description: Unit test class for the {@link DittoProtocolAdapter} in the package org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter. This test verifies the conversion between internal protocol messages and external representations, covering command, response, event, acknowledgement, and subscription message types, as well as topic path parsing.

classes.name: DittoProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of {@link DittoProtocolAdapterV1} transceiving methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the {@link ProtocolAdapter} instance before each test.

methods.name: topicPathFromString
methods.description: Tests conversion of a string topic path into a {@link TopicPath} object.

methods.name: thingErrorResponseFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies correct creation of {@link ThingErrorResponse} from an {@link Adaptable} containing an exception.

methods.name: policyErrorResponseFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies correct creation of {@link PolicyErrorResponse} from an {@link Adaptable} containing an exception.

methods.name: thingModifyCommandFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of an {@link Adaptable} to a {@link ModifyThing} command.

methods.name: thingModifyCommandFromAdaptableWithPolicyToCopy
methods.description: Tests conversion to a {@link ModifyThing} command with a policy copied from another.

methods.name: thingModifyCommandResponseFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion of an {@link Adaptable} to a {@link ThingModifyCommandResponse} with different statuses.

methods.name: thingQueryCommandFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of an {@link Adaptable} into a {@link RetrieveThing} command, with and without selected fields.

methods.name: thingLiveQueryCommandFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a live query {@link Adaptable} into a {@link RetrieveThing} command with live channel header.

methods.name: thingQueryCommandResponseFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion from {@link Adaptable} to {@link RetrieveThingResponse}.

methods.name: thingSearchCommandFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of an {@link Adaptable} to {@link ThingSearchCommand} with and without field selection.

methods.name: subscriptionEventFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion of an {@link Adaptable} into a subscription created event.

methods.name: thingEventFromAdaptable
methods.description: Verifies conversion of an {@link Adaptable} into a {@link ThingModified} event.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertyFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of an {@link Adaptable} to {@link ModifyFeatureProperty} command based on a payload.

methods.name: thingMessageFromAdaptable
methods.description: Checks parsing of certain topic path string to extract thing ID and subject.

methods.name: acknowledgementToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of an {@link Acknowledgement} to an {@link Adaptable}.

methods.name: acknowledgementFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests parsing an {@link Adaptable} back into an {@link Acknowledgement}.

methods.name: acknowledgementsToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts multiple acknowledgements into a single {@link Adaptable}.

methods.name: acknowledgementsFromJson
methods.description: Verifies parsing of acknowledgements from a JSON representation into an {@link Acknowledgements} object.
